description: This file defines a utility class 'NetworkUtil' that provides methods to determine network connectivity status and to generate a user-friendly status message within an Android application.

classes.name: NetworkUtil
classes.description: A utility class for checking network connectivity status and generating corresponding status messages in an Android app.

methods.name: getConnectivityStatus
methods.description: Returns an integer indicating the current network connection type (Wi-Fi, mobile data, or not connected).

methods.name: getConnectivityStatusString
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string of the current network connectivity status.
